# 不空羂索陀羅尼經

**ID:** T1096
**Volume:** T20
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 唐 李無諂譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 700
**Juans:** 1

## Contributors

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tang translation of the **Amoghapāśa-dhāraṇī-sūtra** produced by the lay translator **Lǐ Wúchǎn** ([李無諂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E7%84%A1%E8%AB%82)) of Lampāka (嵐波國, North India) at the **Fóshòujìsì** 佛授記寺 (Buddha-Prophecy Monastery) Translation Cloister in 700 CE — the third year of Wǔ Zétiān's Shènglì 聖曆 era — at the request of the Korean (Silla) monk [明曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%98%8E%E6%9B%89) **Míngxiǎo**. The text is parallel to the Amoghapāśa cycle: T1093 ([KR6j0301](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0301), Jñānagupta), T1094 ([KR6j0302](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0302), Xuánzàng), T1095 ([KR6j0303](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0303), Bodhiruci), and T1097 ([KR6j0305](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0305), Bǎosīwéi). It is uniquely valuable as a witness to a slightly different recension of the Sanskrit *vorlage*: Lǐ Wúchǎn's text contains a more developed *vidyā*-apparatus and ritual procedure than the *hṛdaya*-form translations of Jñānagupta and Xuánzàng.

**Abstract**

The opening narrative situates the discourse at the *kūṭāgāra* (重閣) of the *Sūrya-tilaka* (日輪頂) — a celestial vantage above Mt. Potalaka — with Avalokiteśvara as the discoursing bodhisattva and the standard Mahāyāna audience of bhikṣus, bodhisattvas, and divine retinue. The *mūla-mantra* (the *Amoghapāśa-hṛdaya*), the *vidyā*-formulae, the eighteen *siddhi*-applications, the maṇḍala-construction (a quadrate maṇḍala with the deity at the centre and four guardian-bodhisattvas at the cardinal points), the *abhiṣeka* procedure, and the closing dedication are all expounded. The text's distinguishing feature among the parallel Amoghapāśa translations is its preservation of a particularly elaborate *kuṇḍa* (火爐) and *homa* (護摩) ritual, suggesting access to a slightly later recension of the Sanskrit *vorlage* than the Jñānagupta and Xuánzàng versions.

The dating is fixed by the DILA Buddhist Person Authority record (A000518) and the *Kāiyuán shìjiào lù* 開元釋教錄 ([KR6s0093](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093), T55n2154): *Shènglì sānnián gēngzǐ sānyuè* 聖曆三年庚子三月 — "Shènglì 3, *gēngzǐ* year, third month" = March 700 CE.
